==Skin Trivia==
*The '''Minigunner''' currently has the second most skins for a tower, the first being [[Commander]] with 39 skins.
*The '''Minigunner''' is the most used tower on the game images and videos, such as [[thumbnails]] or [[trailers]].
*Prior to the 8th of August 2019, the Level 5 upgrade was a jetpack. Functionally, it performed the same as any other ground tower.
** Despite being a flying tower, the hitbox of the '''Minigunner''' did not change with the jetpack. They could still be stunned by rocks from [[Tank]]s and shockwaves from the [[Gravekeeper]].
* Some of the features of the '''Minigunner''' were inspired by ''R2DA'' and ''R2D''.
